# Carrier Management features an article on the relationship between legal finance and insurance

September 16, 2024

*Carrier Management* features an article that focuses on what Burford Managing DirectorAndy Lundberg refers to as the "love-hate relationship" between legal finance and the insurance industry.


As Lundberg says, "JPI and legal finance are complementary products; both deal in legal risk, but the water flows in different directions."
